description: This file is a shell script used for testing git fetch negotiation features, including skipping fetch negotiator logic, handling clock skew, and ref advertisement. It contains test cases and helper functions for running git commands and verifying fetch behavior.

methods.name: have_sent
methods.description: Checks if specific commits have been sent during fetch by searching the trace.

methods.name: have_not_sent
methods.description: Checks if specific commits have not been sent during fetch by searching the trace.

methods.name: trace_fetch
methods.description: Wrapper function around git fetch to trace packet output during fetch, disabling certain environment variables to isolate trace data.
